top_3_complaints: Food safety concerns are the most serious: customers describe spoiled or stale food, food poisoning symptoms, and a cockroach in a meal.
Order accuracy creates safety risks: customers report receiving non-vegetarian food instead of vegetarian orders and a dessert containing an allergen.
Payment and refund problems frustrate customers: payments were deducted despite failed transactions, and some refunds remain outstanding.
top_praises: Customers praise tasty, fresh food, especially the biryani.
Customers appreciate fast, on-time delivery and polite delivery partners.
Positive feedback also highlights friendly, attentive staff and an easy-to-use app with reliable tracking.
urgent_attention: Urgently investigate food safety reports and strengthen checks to prevent contaminated food and orders containing the wrong meal or allergens from reaching customers.
action_items: Inspect food handling, storage, and preparation practices, and investigate the reported illness and contamination concerns.
Add a final order check for vegetarian requests and allergy notes before dispatch, confirming the meal and its ingredients match the order.
Reconcile failed-payment deductions and overdue refunds, then resolve affected customer cases and improve payment and refund follow-up.
